title: GitHub duplicate sweep: known HYSYS .hsc and automation repositories
license_public_access_note: GitHub-first sweep resurfaced known repositories already recorded in CASE. Mixed licensing: MIT for some automation/data-only repositories and no explicit license for several repositories exposing .hsc files.
recommended_use: Use as duplicate-avoidance evidence and search-filter tuning; do not download again.
residual_risks: No new licensed HYSYS model payload was found; no files were downloaded.
